04-journey-sign-in.title: Arrive
04-journey-sign-in.text: A visitor opens the portal URL. Nothing requires them to log in to see the home page.

04-journey-sign-in.title: Guest home page
04-journey-sign-in.text: Experience Builder audience rules show the "Guest/Generic" variation: tiles for PO, payment and order management, plus a Log In button that only guests see.

04-journey-sign-in.title: Login
04-journey-sign-in.text: The login page uses the No-Navigation layout. It has the login form and an employee login link. Self-registration is disabled on this site.

04-journey-sign-in.title: Personalised home
04-journey-sign-in.text: After login the same home page re-renders: nav menu and tiles depend on Contact Type(s) and Account Tier.

04-journey-sign-in.title: Check email
04-journey-sign-in.text: Confirmation page; the reset link is sent by email.

04-journey-sign-in.title: Forgot username
04-journey-sign-in.text: A modal on both Login and Forgot Password hosts the Request Username screen flow. The visitor enters their email.

04-journey-sign-in.title: Find username
04-journey-sign-in.text: Subflow reads the User by email. If found and the email is verified it sends the username; if not verified it also sends a verification reminder; if not found it sends a "no user found" email.

04-journey-sign-in.title: Email
04-journey-sign-in.text: The visitor receives the username by email, then logs in.

04-journey-sign-in.title: Account origin: BSO
04-journey-sign-in.text: Users are not self-registered. When a Blanket Sales Order is saved, a record-triggered flow looks for the Materials Coordinator on the Opportunity and invites them.

04-journey-sign-in.title: Invite
04-journey-sign-in.text: Stamps the primary contact on the BSO and invites the contact to the portal.

04-journey-sign-in.title: Account origin: contacts
04-journey-sign-in.text: A primary contact can add colleagues in Contact Management (New Contact subflow: duplicate check, email-domain check, Affiliation record).

04-journey-sign-in.title: User provisioning
04-journey-sign-in.text: Record-triggered flow Create Portal User From Contact creates or reactivates the User and assigns the Customer Portal Access permission set.

04-journey-sign-in.title: Ready
04-journey-sign-in.text: The contact can log in. Removing access publishes a Deactivate Customer Portal User platform event, handled by a subscriber flow.

05-journey-guest-self-service.title: No login
05-journey-guest-self-service.text: These routes do not require login (site is "authenticated with public access enabled"). Guest permissions on the flows and objects were not reviewed here.

05-journey-guest-self-service.title: Submit a PO
05-journey-guest-self-service.text: Intro text plus the PO Submission screen flow.

05-journey-guest-self-service.title: PO flow
05-journey-guest-self-service.text: Matches the contact by email, or the account by email domain; creates a Contact if needed; user picks quotes by number; optional tax-exemption upload; everything is logged in Community Portal Log.

05-journey-guest-self-service.title: Records
05-journey-guest-self-service.text: Community Portal Log, Contact, Task (for the tax form) and file links are written.

05-journey-guest-self-service.title: Back-office
05-journey-guest-self-service.text: Record-triggered flows on Community Portal Log create Cases per quote and send a confirmation.

05-journey-guest-self-service.title: Make a Payment
05-journey-guest-self-service.text: Static rich-text instructions for wire, ACH and mailed payments. No flow.

05-journey-guest-self-service.title: Support form
05-journey-guest-self-service.text: The Support page uses the Webform theme layout.

05-journey-guest-self-service.title: Bot trap
05-journey-guest-self-service.text: If the form is submitted implausibly fast the user lands on a Spam Trap screen; otherwise the case subflow runs.

05-journey-guest-self-service.title: Case creation
05-journey-guest-self-service.text: Reads Customer Portal Cases metadata, matches the Contact, routes to Pedagogical, Physical Materials, Digital Materials or Strategic queue, creates or updates the Case, attaches files and emails the requester.

05-journey-guest-self-service.title: Case
05-journey-guest-self-service.text: Also publishes a Case Web Form Comment platform event; a subscriber flow adds the feed item to the Case.

05-journey-guest-self-service.title: Help Center
05-journey-guest-self-service.text: Help landing, search and Knowledge article viewer with translation links and related articles.

05-journey-guest-self-service.title: Feedback
05-journey-guest-self-service.text: Voting is hidden for collections and unpublished articles.

05-journey-guest-self-service.title: Shipment status
05-journey-guest-self-service.text: Opened from an emailed link carrying a token.

05-journey-guest-self-service.title: Status lookup
05-journey-guest-self-service.text: Logs the request, finds the Opportunity for the PQ and its Integration Data Sync record, and shows status. Invalid orders and errors get their own screens; errors email support.

05-journey-guest-self-service.title: Log
05-journey-guest-self-service.text: Writes and updates a Community Portal Log row for each request.

05-journey-guest-self-service.title: School scheduling
05-journey-guest-self-service.text: Opened by school staff from an emailed link carrying a token.

05-journey-guest-self-service.title: School form
05-journey-guest-self-service.text: Shows school and district; the school completes information or approves the schedule.

05-journey-guest-self-service.title: Tutor record
05-journey-guest-self-service.text: Updating Tutor School Details fires the record-triggered Tutor scheduling automation (about 37 flows).

06-journey-onboarding.title: Starting point
06-journey-onboarding.text: The Primary Onboarding Contact sees all four areas (Professional Development only on tier 3, 3T and 3+ accounts).

06-journey-onboarding.title: Contact Management
06-journey-onboarding.text: Login-required page for maintaining who can use the portal.

06-journey-onboarding.title: Checklist on load
06-journey-onboarding.text: Finds or creates the account's Onboarding Checklist and refreshes its contact-type counts.

06-journey-onboarding.title: Contacts
06-journey-onboarding.text: Display Contacts runs with Input_pageName = cmp. Primary contacts can add contacts (duplicate and email-domain checks, Affiliation), edit roles, invite or remove access.

06-journey-onboarding.title: Records
06-journey-onboarding.text: Onboarding Checklist, Contact and Affiliation records; removing access publishes a deactivation event.

06-journey-onboarding.title: Digital Onboarding
06-journey-onboarding.text: Two tabs: Digital Logistics and Contacts.

06-journey-onboarding.title: Key dates and rostering
06-journey-onboarding.text: The Technical contact selects their Technical Onboarding Case, reviews and submits key dates and rostering information; the Case is updated.

06-journey-onboarding.title: Technical contacts
06-journey-onboarding.text: Same contacts flow with Input_pageName = dop.

06-journey-onboarding.title: Order Management
06-journey-onboarding.text: Three tabs: Shipping addresses, Contacts, Orders.

06-journey-onboarding.title: Addresses
06-journey-onboarding.text: Lists addresses; adds one if none exist; editing clones an address that is already used by an allocation.

06-journey-onboarding.title: Orders
06-journey-onboarding.text: Lists Blanket Sales Orders and starts the allocation journey (Journey 4).

06-journey-onboarding.title: PD
06-journey-onboarding.text: Request PD, Contacts (pd), Scheduled Sessions, Completed Sessions.

07-journey-order-allocation.title: Orders tab
07-journey-order-allocation.text: Materials contacts open the Orders tab on Order Management.

07-journey-order-allocation.title: Choose a BSO
07-journey-order-allocation.text: Shows the account's Blanket Sales Orders, scoped by the IDs from Get User Details.

07-journey-order-allocation.title: Allocation request
07-journey-order-allocation.text: Lists existing Order Allocation Requests for the BSO or starts a new one, creating the OAR and its first Order Allocation. Counts how often it is viewed.

07-journey-order-allocation.title: Edit allocations
07-journey-order-allocation.text: The main editor: quantities of each BSO product per site. Checks for another user having edited (timestamp), for over-allocation, and lets the user cancel sites or the request.

07-journey-order-allocation.title: Site logistics
07-journey-order-allocation.text: Per site: verify delivery details, ship-to contact phone, delivery instructions; marks the allocation confirmed.

07-journey-order-allocation.title: Address fixes
07-journey-order-allocation.text: If required address fields are missing, the address is edited; if it is already used elsewhere it is cloned and allocations are repointed.

07-journey-order-allocation.title: Who may submit
07-journey-order-allocation.text: Unconfirmed sites send the user back to the modal. Only a Materials Contact (or Amplify staff) can proceed to submit.

07-journey-order-allocation.title: Blocked
07-journey-order-allocation.text: Other contacts see a "Not Materials Contact" screen.

07-journey-order-allocation.title: Submit
07-journey-order-allocation.text: Verify-and-submit review, then final confirmation. Backing out unlocks the allocations.

07-journey-order-allocation.title: Statuses
07-journey-order-allocation.text: Order Allocations, the OAR and the BSO are marked submitted.

07-journey-order-allocation.title: Behind the scenes
07-journey-order-allocation.text: Record-triggered flows email the contact (if they allow it), create an internal support case, keep statuses in sync and send reminders.

07-journey-order-allocation.title: Coming next
07-journey-order-allocation.text: orderAllocationManager is a rebuilt single-screen experience. It currently uses mock data and is only reachable at /omp.

08-journey-professional-development.title: PD page
08-journey-professional-development.text: Four tabs: Request PD, Contacts, Scheduled Sessions, Completed Sessions. The page appears in the menu for PD contacts on tier 3, 3T and 3+ accounts.

08-journey-professional-development.title: Request PD
08-journey-professional-development.text: Finds Work Orders and line items in the right status, then the Service Appointments (SAs) available to schedule. Customer picks SAs and fills in details, or files a generic request.

08-journey-professional-development.title: Records
08-journey-professional-development.text: Creates the PD Request with SA and session-topic connector records, and updates the Onboarding Checklist PD stage.

08-journey-professional-development.title: Automation
08-journey-professional-development.text: Record-triggered flows on PD Request set earliest preferred dates and replace legacy workflow rules.

08-journey-professional-development.title: Change a session
08-journey-professional-development.text: Select requested or scheduled SAs, edit them and submit; a new PD Request records the change.

08-journey-professional-development.title: Completed
08-journey-professional-development.text: Table of completed Service Appointments for the account.

08-journey-professional-development.title: Certificates
08-journey-professional-development.text: Public page with two tabs for CTLE certificate registration and retrieval.

08-journey-professional-development.title: Register
08-journey-professional-development.text: Attendee enters a code and personal details. Details are hashed (SHA-256 action plus bcrypt in the browser) before a PD Completion record is created.

08-journey-professional-development.title: PD Completion
08-journey-professional-development.text: The record used for later retrieval.

08-journey-professional-development.title: Retrieve
08-journey-professional-development.text: Attendee re-enters details; the browser compares hashes against matching PD Completion records and offers a PDF download.
